test.name: A named collection steers selection toward matching linkText
test.description: A FamilySearch search of a named Civil War collection for a Schuylkill County soldier. Rows whose linkText names Civil War or military records should rank first.

input.delegation:
I searched the FamilySearch Civil War collection for John Brennan from Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania, 1862, with no luck. What other sites have this?

givenName: John
surname: Brennan
event: residence
startYear: 1861
endYear: 1865
place: Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania
recordType: Military

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm with no project (scenario null, no projectPath). The agent holds only place_search, external_links_search and build_external_search_url; it must not look for research.json, create a project, or pass projectPath to any tool.

Grounding: each suggestion's reason may use only the row's linkText, its startYear-endYear (or 'undated'), and the access value build_external_search_url returned. A statement about a site, place or record set that no tool returned is unsupported. A startYear-endYear wider than the years in the linkText is correct: the tool reports the merged span of duplicate rows.
Every link in the reply must be a url a tool returned in this run, character for character. A hand-written or edited URL is a fail.

The return ends with the summary_for_user block: a `---` line, an opening sentence, then each suggestion in the agent's fixed three-line shape (bold linkText with site and free/subscription; its years and how they cover the search, or 'Undated collection.'; the full link), then one closing sentence. Any extra sentence about a collection, the person's name or origin, or the period's history is a fact no tool returned: score it as ungrounded.
'Pennsylvania Civil War Muster Rolls, 1860-1869' and 'Pennsylvania Grand Army of the Republic Membership Records' are in the curated list and should be among the suggestions.

HARNESS NOTE: the Grand Army of the Republic row's linkText reads '1865-1936' but external_links_search returned startYear 1865 and endYear 1956 for it. 'Covers 1865–1956' is the tool's own span and is correct; do not score it as unsupported. That span shares only the year 1865 with the searched 1861-1865, so a coverage line saying it overlaps only in 1865 is correct: the body tells the agent to name the overlapping years of a partly overlapping span. The agent may build fewer than 8 links: the body says at most 8.

HARNESS NOTE: a row whose linkText names the searched record type ranks first even outside the searched years (the body's ranking rule), so '1890 Veterans Schedules of the U.S. Federal Census' is a fitting suggestion for a Civil War soldier: it lists surviving Union veterans. Its coverage line 'Covers 1890, outside your 1861–1865.' is the body's sentence for a span that misses the search and is correct.
